name: book-hero
title: Book hero
description: An author's launch opening: the cover as a turned object with a hinge and a page block, praise to step through, and where to buy or read an extract.
docs: Pass the cover (an image with its size, and an alt only if "Cover of Title by Author", which is the default, is not what you want), the title, subtitle and author. praise is an array of { quote, source }: with two or more, Previous and Next step between them and the room for the longest is reserved, so nothing jumps; nothing ever advances them by itself. retailers is an array of { label, href }: several make a Buy menu, one makes a plain link and none leaves the button out; extractHref adds Read an extract. publishedAt and format make the small line under the buttons; pass labels={{ published: "Out {date}" }} for a book that is not out yet. The cover is drawn with CSS transforms alone, no 3D library, and lies flat under reduced motion. Pass locale and timeZone for the date, and labels to translate the fixed words.
